repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for file operations on non-UTF-8 text: detects the encoding from the bytes, hands the model UTF-8, and writes back in the original encoding with BOM and CRLF/LF intact. 24 encodings — Cyrillic/CP1251, CP1252, KOI8, ISO-8859, UTF-16, GBK/GB18030.
